title: Nonembedding of Lorentz sequence spaces into Lorentz function spaces
summary: Let $0<p, q<\infty$ with $p \neq q$, and suppose that $p<2$ or $q \leq 1$. We prove that the Lorentz sequence space $\ell_ {p, q}$ does not isomorphically embed into $L_ {p, q}(0,1)$. Consequently, $L_ {p, q}(0, \infty)$ does not isomorphically embed into $L_ {p, q}(0,1)$.
